text: For #678: #393's held-call acceptance tests give each module step ten seconds instead of two, and only the release and cleanup deadline cases, which test the step's watchdog firing, keep two seconds. On CI runners the watchdog killed ordinary held-call steps that ran past two seconds, twice on 2026-11-06 (#664 and #676), and each kill blocked a merge until a rerun. No assertion or refusal case changes, and the driver API's own default stays 5.0 seconds, so the gate's users see no difference.
